Refund Policy

Last updated: [add date]  ·  Carvic Cakes & Bakes, Chennai

This page is a starting template so your site isn't missing this policy — it is not legal advice. Please review and customise it (or have a professional review it) before relying on it for your business.

Cancellations

Orders can be cancelled free of charge up to [add cutoff, e.g. 24 hours] before the scheduled delivery/pickup time. Cancellations closer to the scheduled time may not be eligible for a full refund, since ingredients are often already prepared.

Refund eligibility

  • Order cancelled within the allowed window — full refund
  • Item damaged in transit or incorrect item delivered — full refund or replacement
  • Change of mind after the cutoff window — refund at our discretion

How to request a refund

Message us on WhatsApp with your order details and the reason for the request. We aim to respond within 24 hours.

Refund method

Approved refunds are returned via the original payment method where possible, or as store credit if agreed with the customer.
